name: @office/adapter-construction
description: Office reference construction/CDE provider adapter (OFF-021): a complete Adapter implementation over the @office/adapters-sdk contract — document/RFI/change-event/observation object mappings into the landed canonical command vocabulary, source identity mapping (provider ids never primary keys), replay-safe multi-stream sync, and CDE webhook ingest with explicit conflict records on divergence. Generic provider vocabulary only (adapter kind 'construction-cde'); all provider-specific shapes live inside this package. Ports only: no I/O, no SQL, no clock, no randomness; depends only on @office/adapters-sdk, @office/contracts, and @office/domain-kernel.
